Ride Ramara - Explore Ramara Trails

Event Details

Grab your helmet and come explore Ramara's beautiful trails! 

Whether you're a seasoned cyclist or just looking for a fun morning outdoors, Ride Ramara is organized by the Ramara Trails Committee and welcomes riders of all ages and skill levels.

Ride...







Grab your helmet and come explore Ramara's beautiful trails! 

Whether you're a seasoned cyclist or just looking for a fun morning outdoors, Ride Ramara is organized by the Ramara Trails Committee and welcomes riders of all ages and skill levels.

Ride Dates:
July 22 – Lagoon City Trail
August 26 – Lovely Day Park Bayshore Trail
September 23 – Washago Trail

Rides begin at 9:30 a.m.
Register through Ramara Recreation: 705-325-3091

Bring your bike, invite a friend, and discover the beauty of Ramara - one trail at a time!

Your Community. Your Voice.

The 2026 Municipal and School Board Election is October 26

The Township of Ramara's 2026 Municipal and School Board Election will be held on Monday, October 26, 2026, with online and telephone voting opening on October 8, 2026. Are you Vote Ready? Make sure you’re on the voters’ list, learn how to vote and view the certified list of candidates at ramara.ca/election.

Am I on the Voters’ List?

Check your information and make sure you’re ready to vote. 

When can I vote?

Voting opens October 8 and continues through October 26. 

How can I vote?

Online, by telephone or at an in-person voting opportunity. 

Who is running?

Find out who is running in the 2026 Municipal and School Board Election.
